"""Pure supported-result policy shared by replay and snapshot-only consumers.

Importing this module never imports the engine, solver, profile classifier or a
native dependency. Existing engine imports retain the public re-export.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from .errors import CADException
from .model import Document


def validate_result_version(document: Document, result_version: int) -> None:
    """Reject unsupported output semantics before solving or building geometry."""
    if type(result_version) is not int or result_version not in (1, 2):
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_result_version", "Only replay result versions 1 and 2 are supported."
        )
    from .sketch_model import sketch_capabilities

    required = max(
        (
            sketch_capabilities(feature.sketch.schema_version).required_result_version
            for feature in document.features
            if feature.sketch is not None
        ),
        default=1,
    )
    if result_version < required:
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_result_version",
            f"This document uses sketch schema {required}. Upgrade the add-on/sidecar "
            f"together and request result_version {required}.",
        )
